china-1923:p0239_1.rationale: Directory of Kwangtung newspapers and periodicals by title, place, proprietor and frequency; content is textual. Daily and weekly papers and monthly journals are both listed, so the periodicals tag is a partial fit.
review_questions: Table mixes newspapers and periodicals; consider whether a combined press-directory tag is needed.

china-1923:p0255_1.rationale: Values of Chinese exports and re-exports by commodity for 1913, 1920 and 1921, with recalculated values at 1913 prices. A broad multi-commodity export table.
review_questions: Printed total row does not add up and is kept as read.

china-1923:p0257_1.rationale: Reference list pairing principal products (animal products, fibres, metals, seeds, timber, sundries) with producing regions. Content is textual and spans many commodities, so no single tag fits.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for regional distribution of products or a multi-sector product inventory.

china-1923:p0258_1.rationale: Province-by-province list of principal products with export ports and remarks; textual and multi-commodity, so no specific tag fits.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for product-by-province or port-of-export inventories.

china-1923:p0266_1.rationale: Percentage share of world raw silk trade by China, Japan, Western Europe and the Levant for 1911-1916. Silk is the subject, but the tag silk covers manufacture or trade, and it fits here as a trade-share series.

china-1923:p0266_2.rationale: Annual quantities in piculs of Chinese silk exports by type (white, yellow, filature, wild, waste), 1910-1921. Cocoons are one column among silk types.
review_questions: Some 1920-1921 figures are unreadable; the years 1917 and 1918 appear out of order in the source.

china-1923:p0267_1.rationale: Value in Haikwan taels of China's silk exports for 1918-1921.

china-1923:p0278_1.rationale: Quantity of raw cotton used in Chinese mills by origin (Chinese, American, East Indian, Egyptian) for a half year.

china-1923:p0279_1.rationale: Quantity and value of vegetable oil exports from China, 1919-1921.

china-1923:p0280_1.rationale: Original tobacco exports from Customs districts in piculs, 1917-1921.
